getgid: Returns the real group ID of the calling process.
setgid: Set the real group ID of the calling process. Accepts a numeric ID or a group name, resolved via `getgrnam`.
getegid: Returns the effective group ID of the calling process.
setegid: Set the effective group ID of the calling process. Accepts a numeric ID or a group name, resolved via `getgrnam`.
getuid: Returns the real user ID of the calling process.
setuid: Set the real user ID of the calling process. Accepts a numeric ID or a username, resolved via `getpwnam`.
geteuid: Returns the effective user ID of the calling process.
seteuid: Set the effective user ID of the calling process. Accepts a numeric ID or a username, resolved via `getpwnam`.
getgroups: Returns the supplementary group IDs of the calling process.
getgrnam: Look up a group by name, returning its `Group` record or `null` if it doesn't exist.
getpwnam: Look up a user by name, returning its `Passwd` record or `null` if it doesn't exist.
Group: A POSIX group record, as returned by `getgrnam`.
Passwd: A POSIX user record, as returned by `getpwnam`.
Passwd.gecos: The user's full name or comment field.
